black_frames.threshold: no black run > 0.5 s unless the scene marks it intended

missing_kit.threshold: magenta share <= 0.2% in every 1 fps frame
missing_kit.detail: magenta pixel share in sampled frames

originality.threshold: corpus: run < 8 and 5-gram share < 2% per source; source: share < 1% and run < 6

sameness.threshold: FAIL: title>=0.6 (and subject words >=0.6; template only = WARN), hook>=0.6, same topic, thumb_hamming<=8, script>=0.15, frames_hamming<=10; WARN: beats_ned<=0.1 vs 3+, shot_mix>=0.95, cover_hamming<=8, same subject/source
sameness.detail: no published history to compare against

source_title.threshold: title trigram >= 0.6 with the same subject words, or a 5-word run with a subject word, vs the source title = FAIL; same template on another subject = WARN
source_title.detail: vs source title "Why The Ocean's Deadliest Predator Refuses To Kill Us"

safe_area.threshold: FAIL: screen-fixed text, or a 1-line caption page, ending below 80 % of the height; WARN: anything (2-line captions) below 66 %, or a text layer within 5 % of an edge
safe_area.detail: 0 fail, 1 warn (storyboard geometry; camera moves are not modelled)

value.text: It flips great whites, kills blue whales, and wrecks yachts.

value.line: Narration: synthetic AI voice (Kokoro TTS). Animation: original 2D vector art.

disclosure.threshold: AI-voice disclosure in every platform's caption
disclosure.detail: AI-voice line in youtube, tiktok and instagram captions
